title: Chicken Egg Size Trend by Flock
dataSources: Hive metrics (`flowhive:reading`), egg counter events (`eggcounter:event`), goat RFID visits (`goattag:scan`), goat watering and feed logs (`goatcare:event`), and compost readings (`compost:reading`).
app: Smallholding and backyard telemetry from Flow Hive scales, chicken coop counters, RFID goat tags, compost thermometers, and camera-driven chore logs sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=eggcounter:event
| search egg_weight_g=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(egg_weight_g) as avg_egg_weight_g by _time flock_name
| sort - _time
description: Tracks average egg size over time and breaks it out by flock.
value: Egg-size trend adds quality context to plain count data and can reveal feed or health changes.
implementation: Send average egg size events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of average egg size by flock.
grandmaExplanation: It produces how average egg size changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
